fix(agentd): use existing assertions in composed qualification tests

Remove one unresolved pretty_assertions import from the concurrently composed Agentd tests and use the standard assert_eq macro already available in the crate. Both complete-value assertions, their inputs and order remain unchanged. No dependency, lockfile, authorization behavior, test roster or budget changes.

Retain ff19's 17 recovery and 120 source-check passes and its dispatcher compilation failure as results of that exact source. This new commit requires its own validation. DRAFT/HOLD only.
